in_game_description: The bright, vibrant core of an asteroid from the Void world. This will definitely fetch a high price on the open market.
mechanics_text: Highest-priced asteroid core in the base game (tied with Novanium Core).
One of only two cores (with Novanium Core) that cannot be found at any Hangar unless placed there.
The only ore core not named 'Core' — it is called 'Void Essence'.
If you bring Netor more than one Void Crystal, he will only return one for constructing the Disruptor Laser.
